queries.query: Determining whether a PFAS destructive treatment achieved meaningful destruction. Prepare a focused review of the measurements needed to distinguish disappearance of a target PFAS from transformation, defluorination, and broader destruction.
Compare parent-compound loss, transformation-product analysis, fluoride release, fluorine mass balance, and mineralization-related endpoints.
Evaluate how analytical scope, sampling time, detection limits, and unidentified products affect interpretation.
Define a defensible evidence hierarchy for reporting destruction while preserving technology, matrix, and scale limitations.
